title: Props, every state
prompt: Paint one sheet of cut-out puppet parts for a paper-puppet film, using the attached image. Panel A is the exact layout, panel B is our footage for these props (reference: copy the object, not the photo style), panel C is the style. STYLE (panel C): flat cards cut from corrugated cardboard, gouache with confident ink linework, the flutes faintly showing through the paint, a thin raw kraft-brown cut edge round every card, brass split-pin brads; shot flat-on, even light, no shadows, no perspective. Copy the craft from C, not the clothes in it. WHAT (panel B): the props of the poem 'Magic Ride', one row each, every state of a prop in its own cell, left to right: the motorcycle: a black naked cafe motorcycle: chrome-edged scuffed steel tank, round headlight, raked fork, two spoked wheels. No still fits. (parked, plates empty, plates filling (rubbed), ridden skeleton, parked at the chapel); the glint on the tank: one small white star of light on the tank, the poem's only accent. No still fits. (moonlit, last spark at dawn, sunlit, double-click); the nest tree: a lone roadside tree with a twig nest in a fork; birds burst out as the bike passes (night, still, birds bursting); the setting moon: the same cream disc as 09, shrinking a little as it settles to the skyline (high, settling, gone); the morning sun: a pale gold disc with soft rays, low in the east. No still fits. (rising, up); traffic streaks: other cars and scooters only as headlight and taillight streaks (streaming). Paint each state as a flat cardboard prop card at the size its cell gives, the same object across its row; a brass brad on the green cross (its pivot); where there is a red cross, that is where a hand grips it. LAYOUT (panel A): paint one card inside each grey ghost, in the same place, size and angle, inside its dashed outline; a brass brad exactly on every green cross; each red cross must fall inside that card's rounded end. NEVER draw a pelvis, hip, shorts or briefs card (the thighs end in a rounded seat that tucks under the hem), a sleeveless vest, lace-up boots, or sunglasses painted onto a head. OUTPUT: only the painted cards on a pure white 2048x1152 sheet laid out as panel A. Leave out panels B and C, the crosses, labels, ruler, dashed lines and ghosts.
